value.rationale: The 4-by-7 doubly periodic square grid is a canonical coprime hard-square torus for the classic negative-activity/Euler-characteristic problem. Its alternating index alone permits radically different homotopy types and does not reveal that three integral homology classes occupy adjacent degrees. The mixed two-five-sphere plus one-six-sphere decomposition is a natural exact finite classification, strengthens known information and gives a substantive boundary to inferring single-sphere topology from coprime signed enumeration.
